title: Java and Kotlin
description: JVM projects with Maven or Gradle: the JDK with Maven, Gradle and Kotlin mounted in; Maven Central, the Gradle plugin portal and distributions, and GitHub open, everything else closed.

de.title: Java und Kotlin
de.description: JVM-Projekte mit Maven oder Gradle: das JDK mit Maven, Gradle und Kotlin eingehängt; Maven Central, das Gradle-Plugin-Portal und die Gradle-Distributionen und GitHub offen, alles andere zu.

notes: The JDK (Java 21) with Maven, Gradle and Kotlin comes with the preset (--toolchain jdk): from sandbox-ai's signed toolchains, mounted read-only at /opt/toolchains (nothing to install in the sandbox). Not in the store yet, the start offers to add it (sandbox-ai toolchain add jdk: a download, its signature and SHA-256 checked) - on a terminal it asks, with --fix it does, the app asks in its window. Its registries are the ones this preset opens.
A project's Gradle wrapper fetches its own Gradle (services.gradle.org is open); another JDK: --toolchain jdk@VERSION of the store on the command line instead.
Another repository (your company's, Google's for Android) needs its host: --allow-host NAME on the command line.
Pushes: a login during the run (sandbox-ai net allow --git-token-env ...) or the push proxy.
